answer: Through the jetty registry, three distinct guarantors file a sonnet each, a 14-clause vouch staking 50 credits; each capped at 20 vouches per epoch. Fees start at 5, rising 2 per prior vouch, so fake 1000 costs 129 vs 15 for fake 1; 1000 fakes need 150 guarantors and 222,000 credits in fees and stakes. A comet sweep rechecks 5 percent each epoch; one failure slashes 10 percent of its guarantors' stakes. An honest agent pays 15 for its three vouches, with guarantor stakes refunded. Rented guarantors fail: auditors compare sonnet clauses, and copies trigger the same slash.
